layers.name: Platform & Tooling
layers.description: Project-level documentation, build tooling, Docker assets, and editor configuration.

layers.name: Payload Core
layers.description: Payload configuration, collections, globals, access control, hooks, and CMS plugins.

layers.name: Shared Domain Utilities
layers.description: Reusable domain logic for SEO, navigation, forms, media, and URL handling.

layers.name: Content Rendering

layers.name: Application Delivery
layers.description: Next.js app-router pages, API routes, admin entry points, and route-level server logic.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the project README and package manifest to understand the application stack and local workflow.

tour.title: Payload Bootstrap
tour.description: The Payload config is the operational center that registers collections, globals, storage, email, and plugins.

tour.title: Content Model
tour.description: Collections and globals define the editable site structure, publishing rules, and reusable settings.

tour.title: Editorial Rules & Side Effects
tour.description: Access checks, hooks, and shared utilities enforce business rules around page hierarchy, redirects, and navigation synchronization.

tour.title: Frontend Data Flow
tour.description: The frontend app router fetches CMS data, handles fallback modes, and turns page documents into renderable blocks.

tour.title: Block Rendering
tour.description: Blocks and shared components define how CMS-managed layouts become concrete React UI.

tour.title: Form Submission Pipeline
tour.description: The public forms route validates submissions, stores them through Payload, and sends notifications when configured.

tour.title: Presentation & Runtime
tour.description: Styles, themes, and Docker assets shape how the application is delivered and themed across environments.
